samples.description: Firm-level 1993–1998 Table 3 sample after the source-supported six-year CONMKT support fit, rating, market-model, annual-accounting, and available-year RNDADV screens. Panel B uses elig_acc in the same file and adds available-year CONACC. Native-currency LEV and RNDADV ratios remove exactly canceled same-date exchange-rate requirements without filling missing inputs; per-variable year counts are retained. Published Ns are 704 and 632.

assumptions: Direct cross-sectional OLS with intercept; the paper does not identify the estimator.
vce(robust) is the Stata heteroskedasticity-robust translation; exported p-values are two-sided, while Table 3 uses one-tailed p-values where predicted.

BTM uses CEQ in USD over same-PERMCO company market equity summed across active ordinary-common share classes when all class values are available and active LC/LU/LS links resolve to one matching GVKEY; unresolved company dates are unavailable and primary-security values are retained only for audit. The auxiliary model uses fiscal-year CRSP return compounding and the documented extraction filters.

CRSP and FX source histories extend through 31 May 1999, the observed maximum FY1998 DATADATE; the Jan–Dec 1998 market-model window and pre-1 Sep 1998 rating-type screen retain their distinct source meanings.
LEV and RNDADV use native same-date ratios because their common currency conversion factor cancels algebraically; no missing item is replaced with zero.
The paper explicitly requires six-year BTM and return histories but does not state a minimum available-year count for explanatory accounting means; observed-year means and valid-year counts are used.
Direct cross-sectional OLS with intercept; the paper does not identify the estimator.

The paper does not name a depreciation item. Current Compustat DP is depreciation and amortization (legacy A14), used as a broad proxy for depreciation expense; legacy XDP (A103) coverage is retained as a diagnostic.

CRSP and FX source histories extend through 31 May 1999, the observed maximum FY1998 DATADATE; the Jan–Dec 1998 market-model window and pre-1 Sep 1998 rating-type screen retain their distinct source meanings.
CONACC averages valid annual ratios over available years without zero-filling missing inputs; at least one valid year is required.
vce(robust) is the Stata heteroskedasticity-robust translation; exported p-values are two-sided, while Table 3 uses one-tailed p-values where predicted.

limitations: Current local Compustat/CRSP vintages do not establish the authors’ exact 1998 source vintage or historical link policy.
The source does not identify exact BTM components, the annual return compounding convention, or minimum available-year counts for accounting means.
SPLTICRM-to-legacy-SPDRC field equivalence is best-effort; only pre-1998-09 senior-debt-rating records are used for the rated-cohort screen.
The 2004 guide maps XDP A103 to depreciation expense, while DP A14 is depreciation and amortization; DP is a current broad proxy and XDP-based coverage is reported diagnostically.

The main CCM panel includes provider-documented LC and LU primary links; LU is unresearched rather than invalid. LC-only coverage is retained as a diagnostic comparison, not a paper-imposed sample screen.

Company market equity uses the active ordinary-common share values in the selected primary PERMCO/month when prices and shares are complete and used LC/LU/LS links across those classes resolve to one GVKEY. A bounded audit distinguishes unmapped common issues from PERMCO/months linked to multiple GVKEYs; unresolved BTM firm-years remain missing, while coherent single- and multi-class observations remain eligible.
